title: The Asia Business Daily writes about The London Disputes Report 2026
summary: The Asia Business Daily writes about The London Disputes Report 2026. Learn more.
body_markdown:
Burford Capital's[latest research](https://www.burfordcapital.com/insights-news-events/insights-research/2026-the-london-disputes-report/) with *The Lawyer* on the economics of commercial disputes is featured by *The Asia Business Daily* , highlighting the finding that many strong legal claims are never pursued because of cost and risk, and exploring the growing role of legal finance in helping businesses manage disputes more strategically.


[Read the full article here.](https://www.asiae.co.kr/en/article/lawtimes/2026071515405626827)
